paper_title: Hetrify: Efficient Verification of Heterogeneous Programs on RISC-V

claims.statement: Hetrify achieves 100% correct verification rate for correct RISC-V assembly programs at unwind factor 20.
claims.evidence_quote: For correct programs, a 100% success rate was achieved at an unwind factor of 20

claims.statement: Hetrify reaches 96% correct rate and 0% error rate for incorrect RISC-V assembly programs with no unwind limit.
Post-conversion verification of large heterogeneous programs with missing source functions reaches 100% correct rate with no errors.

overall_conclusion: Hetrify enables effective RISC-V low-level and heterogeneous program verification by converting binaries and assembly into verifiable C code, achieving high verification rates and zero verification errors in key experimental settings.
comparable_notes: Experiments used CBMC v5.95 on Ubuntu 22.04 with a 3000-second timeout. Assembly programs came from SV-COMP 2024, and large heterogeneous programs from SV-COMP 2024/2023. Correct programs used fixed unwind factors while incorrect programs used higher or no unwind bounds.
